crossRefs.note: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make…
They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat: for the days of my people will be like…
I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;
Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks…

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
translations.bsb: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
translations.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
translations.asv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
